_about: Egg karaoke recordings for the Christmas pack (js/packs/christmas.js), generated with tools/gen-sounds.js --manifest tools/packs/christmas.karaoke.json and chosen, pitched and levelled by tools/pick-karaoke.js --manifest tools/packs/christmas.karaoke.json. inst/sleighbells (unpitched: the jingle world's off-beat tick and its chirp) and inst/celesta (the jingle world's lead) are new instruments; the rest of the band reuses the Classic recordings. sing = each friend's sound in the band (a held note sings, anything else plays as it is); extra = its ad-lib.
common: close-up, isolated, no music, no speech, no background noise
commonInst: one single isolated note, dry studio recording, no reverb, no other instruments, no melody
